title: Architectural 3D CAD & Construction
summary: First-principles architectural design, 3D CAD modeling in Blender, and structural construction execution of a two-story home in Bandung.
highlights: Self-taught architectural drafting and 3D structural modeling designed completely from scratch in Blender.
Engineered on-site construction realization on an 8x12-meter plot without formal architectural credentials.
Complete building lifecycle: engineered as a 330 kVA GPU datacenter, now thriving as a family-friendly home.
